Title: Diagnosis
Details: The failing test `testLinearCombinationWithSingleElementArray` in `MathArraysTest` aims to test `MathArrays.linearCombination` when passed single-element arrays. The current bug report describes an `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException` in `MathArrays.linearCombination`, specifically mentioning the line `double prodHighNext = prodHigh[1];` causing the issue. This indicates that `linearCombination` is not handling single-element arrays properly and is assuming the presence of a second element in an array. To resolve this, `linearCombination` should check the length of the input arrays and handle the case where the length is 1 by falling back to simple multiplication instead of array access.

The root cause of the issue is the assumption of a second element in the array without proper length check in the `linearCombination` method.
